Record Class LeaderboardEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.it.network.server.persistence.LeaderboardEntry
Record Components:
rank - 1-based position in the leaderboard (0 if the row was produced outside a ranked query)
nickname - nickname of the player
finalScore - prestige points at the end of the game
numPlayers - number of players that took part in the game
playedAt - when the game was completed
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record LeaderboardEntry(int rank, String nickname, int finalScore, int numPlayers, LocalDateTime playedAt) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable row of the leaderboard.

Represents one (player, game) result as stored in the database: it carries all the fields required by the specification — nickname, final score, date of the game and number of players — plus a rank field computed on the fly when the row is returned as part of a ranked leaderboard query.

Implements Serializable so it can be ferried over both Sockets (Java object serialisation is not used by this project, but the contract is kept consistent with the other DTOs) and inside the JSON payload of Message.
